preamble: Affrication of the palatalized stop [tʲ] to the alveolar affricate [ts], with loss of palatality. The Proto-Slavic soft *ť (from *tj) became West Slavic c [ts] in Czech, Slovak, Polish and Sorbian, while East and South Slavic gave other reflexes (Russian č, Serbo-Croatian ć).

examples.to: Czech svíce, Slovak svieca, Polish świeca, Upper Sorbian swěca (all with c [ts])
examples.note: Compare Russian свеча svečá [tɕ] and Serbo-Croatian svijéća [tɕ], which show the other reflexes of *ť.
